description: FREE over MCP: 5 calls per day in total, one pool shared by agent_trust-badge and reputation_lookup; no wallet, no API key. A lookup that finds nothing does not use one. Free only when the call carries NO payment: a call that sends a payment or starter-credit note is charged. queryable trust badge for an agent holding a BlindOracle passport: AUDITED when an in-date BlindOracle security audit of its code is on record (with risk score, proof id and expiry), otherwise identity only. An agent with no record returns UNVERIFIED, never a synthetic score. After the free calls: $0.01 USDC via x402 (network eip155:8453).
